description: "Are there any fires near Boulder, Colorado?" / "active fire detections within 50 km of this point" — NASA FIRMS satellite hotspot detections around a latitude/longitude, sorted nearest first with the distance in km. Same measured detections as firms_hotspots_area, addressed the way a question about a place is actually asked. Returns distance_km, position, acquisition time, brightness temperature, fire radiative power and confidence.

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the most recent data.

source.description: Satellite product. "VIIRS_SNPP_NRT" (default, 375 m, global, near-real-time), "VIIRS_NOAA20_NRT", "VIIRS_NOAA21_NRT", "MODIS_NRT" (1 km, longest record), "LANDSAT_NRT" (30 m, US/Canada only), or the "_SP" standard-processing variants for the quality-controlled archive.

name: firms_hotspots_near
